tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind the plan diagram.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Steps, pills, the chat panel, pop-ups. Text on it is ink, ink-2 or muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, step outlines, primary buttons. Text on ground, surface, needs-you, thread and bubble.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface and thread: a step's second line, pill labels, thread details.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet text on ground and surface: placeholders, the product label, faded steps.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: pill outlines, faded step outlines, the chat panel edge. Never text.

tokens.name: flow
tokens.usage: Arrows and lines between steps, and the dashed outline of a notice.

tokens.name: needs-you
tokens.usage: The one attention colour. Fills a step that is waiting on the person, and nothing else. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: tested
tokens.usage: The tick on a step whose tests pass. On surface only. Never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: thread
tokens.usage: Side questions and reviewer threads in the chat, and the hover behind a traceable number. Text on it is ink or ink-2.

tokens.name: bubble
tokens.usage: The person's own messages, and button hover. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill: primary buttons and a pressed toggle.

styles.name: fah-title
styles.usage: The goal above the diagram. One per screen.
styles.sample: Can I cover each wedding payment on its due date?

styles.name: fah-question
styles.usage: The question inside a decision block.
styles.sample: Which guest count should the plan be built on?

styles.name: fah-step-name
styles.usage: A step's name, and a result that came out of it.

styles.name: fah-body
styles.sample: With a total of 43,000, the second payment is 18,500.

styles.name: fah-small
styles.usage: A step's second line, thread headers, pop-up rows.

styles.name: fah-label
styles.usage: The product label, the step chip in a message.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a pill row and its step.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Step padding top and bottom; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Step and message padding left and right.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between chat messages; pop-up padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Chat panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Grid pitch on the cover.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Diagram margin from the frame edge.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between step columns, which an arrow crosses.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The step chip in a message.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Steps and buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Threads, the decision block, the message box, pop-ups.

tokens.name: radius-step-you
tokens.usage: A step that is a figure from the person: half the step height, so it reads as a pill.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The step pop-up, and a step on hover. The only shadow.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, selection.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Things entering: a message, a pop-up, a thread opening, a fill change.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: A step's new line arriving.

tokens.name: dur-draw
tokens.usage: The tick drawing, and one pulse travelling along an arrow.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or responds.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: The pulse along an arrow.
